evaluator_config.message_template: Recursive function '{name}' missing depth limit protection

rationale: Unbounded recursion causes stack overflow, which is an unrecoverable process-level failure. It bypasses all error handling mechanisms. A recursive function without depth limits is a denial-of-service vulnerability.
remediation: Add a max_depth parameter and validate depth at each call. Prefer iterative solutions over recursive.

guidance.explanation: The correct version has a max_depth parameter that limits recursion depth. The incorrect version has no depth limit, risking stack overflow on deep trees.
